content: {"reasoning":"CO-197 denial is for missing prior auth at time of service. This payer does not offer retroactive authorization or peer-to-peer, and I already filed an appeal with medical necessity. There is no valid pathway to overturn a hard prior-auth requirement here, and resubmission would be improper. The remaining balance cannot be billed to the patient since a provider-side auth failure (CO-197) is provider liability, not patient responsibility.","action":"write_off"}
